scientific_integrity: All parameter data and standalone exact-verification code are embedded, with no floating-point rank computations. Finite-field nonvanishing is lifted to complex characteristic zero using a cyclotomic specialization.
scientific_limitations: Exact secant dimensions for q=7 and orders 1..16 only; no proof of first filling at 17, generic width, full family of prime powers, or independent validation. Historical-priority risk remains.
title: Penultimate secants of the order-seven Heisenberg bilinear channel varieties are nondefective
